description.narrative: The project is implemented in Zimbabwe. The main target groups are women and girls living with HIV/AIDS. Through trainings, mobilizing, campaigns, networking and materials production, the project aims to achieve that more of the women living with HIV and AIDS in the targeted communities are demanding and accessing health services to a greater extent.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between Woman AIDS Support Network (WASN) and The Palme Center.WASN works for and with the women and girls to uplift their status in the era of HIV and AIDS. WASN from the onset has been spearheading issues of HIV transmission, prevention, treatment, care and support in relation to women and girls who have been treated as second class citizens. WASN has been thriving to get the women to be treated for any minor ailments and being able to demand and access various services they have been deprived of. WASN will mobilise women and girls and educate them on the their rights to treatment.Other Donors to the OrganisationFunding for project constitutes a third of total budget, they also receive some revenue from rentals.Project ObjectiveIncreasing women and girls s access to information to improve their abilities to make decisions and choices on HIV, Gender Based Violence (GBV), sexual reproductive health and rights through educational workshops, one-to-one counselling and information disseminationEnsuring women and girls have access to appropriate services that are supported by relevant policies and well resourced programme. This is achieved in the Mobile Clinic Project through direct provision of treatment for STIs and other diseases through partnering with local health service providers, building better relationships between health services providers and the community.Reducing the incidences of violence, HIV, stigma, discrimination and negative cultural and religious practices through popularization of the Domestic Violence Act and creating better working relationships between the local law enforcement agents and women in the community.WASN Mobile clinic seeks to achieve realisation of human rights and promote health well-being of all by reaching out to hard to reach areas and achieve gender equality and empowerment of all women and girls. Through the trainings the women and girls are empowered.
